title: Replace SkeletonSnapshot list priority queue with ordered set
description:
Remove the quadratic-looking RemoveAt(0) plus repeated Sort pattern from SkeletonSnapshot.Capture while preserving the exact deterministic bone ordering contract. This is a bounded implementation-quality improvement; it must not change semantic ordering or snapshot compatibility.

## Scope
- Replace pending List/BFS-style priority queue mechanics with a SortedSet ordered by the existing ordinal bone-ID comparer.
- Preserve root validation, parent-before-child ordering, duplicate detection, cycle detection, and exact observable bone order.
- Keep the snapshot public API unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- No pending.RemoveAt(0) or whole-pending-list Sort remains in SkeletonSnapshot.Capture.
- Existing deterministic ordering tests remain valid.
- Parent indices remain strictly earlier than child indices.
- No public API or semantic ordering changes are introduced.

## Validation
- Runtime and runtime-test builds pass.
- Existing SkeletonSnapshot tests cover ordering, root contract, cycles, and parent-before-child behavior.
- git diff --check passes.

comments.body: Takeover audit: confirmed SkeletonSnapshot.Capture used a List as a priority queue via pending[0], RemoveAt(0), AddRange, and repeated Sort. Replaced the pending structure with SortedSet<Bone> using the existing CompareBonesById ordering. This preserves the same next-bone selection policy while avoiding front-removal and whole-pending-list resorting. No public API change. Unity execution remains the final executable validation gate when available.
